title: Modified total RNA extraction for Heterosigma akashiwo using the Qiagen RNeasy kit
author: Monica Accerbi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.hipb4dn

steps.title: Prepare Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 1 ml of culture (containing approximately 400,000 cells) at 2,000 to 3,000 rpm for 2 minutes at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in the residual liquid (approximately 1 ml)

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of Buffer RLT containing 10 µl β-mercaptoethanol to the cells.

steps.title: Homogenize Sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture through a QIAshredder column at 11,000 rpm for 1 minute, processing 750 µl at a time.

substeps.instruction: Collect the flow through (FT) in a 5 ml tube

steps.title: Prepare for RNA Binding
steps.instruction: Add 2 ml of 70% (v/v) ethanol to the collected flow through and mix at room temperature.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture through a RNeasy spin column at 11,000 rpm for 1 minute, processing 750 µl at a time.

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer RW1
steps.instruction: Add 750 µl Buffer RW1 and centrifuge at 11,000 rpm for 1 minute.

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer RPE
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 500 µl Buffer RPE and centrifuge at 11,000 rpm for 1 minute.

substeps.instruction: Repeat this wash step once more

steps.title: Dry the Membrane
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column once more at 11,000 rpm for 1 minute to dry the membrane and remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Elute Total RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the total RNA using DEPC (Diethyl pyrocarbonate)-treated H2O.

substeps.instruction: Use 15 µl for standard elution, or 25-30 µl as an alternative volume
